caption: The drawing depicts an oblong, oval-shaped metal tray with a slightly raised rim, seen from a top-down perspective. The tray is primarily rendered in shades of gray and black, with intricate gold detailing. Along the border of the tray, there is a repeating pattern of small silver or white dots. Inside the border, the surface of the tray features decorative gold floral and leaf motifs that curve around the inner edge. At the center of the tray, there is an oval medallion with a complex gold design consisting of two circular shapes connected with curved, feather-like lines and additional embellishments. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, which contrasts with the darker tones of the tray and makes it stand out. The overall composition focuses solely on the tray without any additional objects present.
title: Bread Tray
